violations.text: Raw animal foods eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods noodles in the 3 door lowboy. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Chicken, and beans, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Chicken was observed at 51 DF, and beans were observed at 48 DF. Beans and chicken were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Various food was observed held between 44-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the deli display cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, food items were stocked in cooler 2 hours prior to inspection. All food items were moved to walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in deli display cooler until it is able to keep and internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Various food was observed held between 43-44 degrees Fahrenheit in specific parts of the walk-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Establishment is to ensure that walk-in cooler is able to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Establishment is to monitor walk-in cooler temperatures. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The cutting boards in the deli are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The walk-in cooler, and deli display case was observed fluctuating in temperatures and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Box of bananas were observed with an accumulation of mold build up. Bananas were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Raw animal foods chicken were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods ground beef in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Proper food storage reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils slicer and ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was emptied and put out of order at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use ice machine or slicer until they are properly cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Salami, chicken, fries, pork, and empanadas were observed held between 100-110 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food was reheated, and hot-holding unit was turned up at the time of inspection. Establishment is to monitor and ensure that all hot food is being held at 135 DF or higher. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Various food was observed being held between 42-45 degrees Fahrenheit in the walk-in cooler, 3 door lowboy, deli display case #1 and deli display case #2. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Technician arrived at the time of inspection to service units. Establishment is to monitor temperatures and ensure that all units are able to keep internal food temperatures at 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Various food was observed held between 45-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the dessert cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food in unit was evaluated at the time of inspection. Any food observed at 46 DF or higher was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. All other food was moved to properly functioning refrigeration. Technician arrived to service units at the time of inspection. Establishment is to monitor temperatures and ensure that all units are able to keep internal food temperatures at 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, empanadas were placed hot in the refrigerator, stacked, and tightly covered. Empanadas were portioned and uncovered at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The presence of cockroaches is not controlled as evidenced by live activity in kitchen space. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to work with a licensed pest control company/technician to eliminate pest problem and is to have a detailed pest control report for the inspector at the time of next inspection. Establishment is to follow pest control recommendations. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and kitchen area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

-The 3 door lowboy gasket was observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. -The Walk-in cooler, both deli display cases, 3 door lowboy, and dessert cases were observed in poor repair, not maintaining an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Equipment must be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in fans, and refrigeration shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The right wall in the kitchen is constructed of wood. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. Per PIC, stainless steel will be put up. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The water tank room and edges of floor in the retail area, have an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
The ceiling tiles in the basement ware washing area were observed missing. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026
A sponge was observed in the hand-washing sink in the meat area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025
The hand-washing sink in the meat area is lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025

Sausage was observed held at 102 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025

The door to the outside, located in the walk-in cooler, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Per interview with PIC, service has been contacted. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025
Drinks and meats were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler/freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed torn and in poor repair. Per interview with PIC, part has been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving, fans, gaskets have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2024

Recently sliced cheese was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit in prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff moved to refrigeration to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/04/2024
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety registered with RIDOH/CFP. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2024

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Staff set-up sanitizer in 3-bay during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

Chicken was observed held between 115- and 120- degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

Cheese, ham, and sliced tomatoes in prep unit were observed held at 49-50, degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

Chicharones and beef prepared 2/17/23 were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, portioned chicken and beef prepared in the morning were placed warm in the prep unit to cool. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024
The area surrounding the dumpster had debris and litter. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

The walls in the basement area are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. A hole was observed near the walk-in refrigerator, black residue was observed on rear wall. New Violation. Correct By: 03/04/2024
